name: Miria
source:
A spirited, cheerful, and earnest girl. A dragon half-breed born to a human father and a dragon mother. Both parents are deceased, and she lives with her grandfather.

Her appearance is identical to a human's, and she was raised as one by her grandfather, though she knows her mother was a dragon.

She ends up accompanying Kane as the guardian of the “Hypnotic Magic Crystal,” a memento from her mother...

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid2/charactor01.html]Official website[/url]]
